title: Biased variance bounded by total influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $0<p<1$. Under the product distribution on signs with $\Pr[X_i=-1]=p$ independently for each coordinate, the variance of $f$ is at most its total product influence.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
